info.name: MetroMatrix — Chunk 5 (Kitchen Intelligence)
info.description: Kitchen stock, recipes, purchases, costing, price watch, waste, forecast and prep, smart ETA, outage pause, Bachat Box, voice and the announcement (5A); tiffin, catering, Ramadan, storefront, story and hygiene, signature, demand map and curve, menu engineering, experiments and rider batching (5B); menu assistant, nutrition, My Kitchen and staff tools (5C). Needs seed:food + seed:kitchen and a server with AI_ENABLED=false (generated by scripts/gen-kitchen-postman.mjs).
